home.heroTitle: Ngā rā uaua, ngā rā tūmanako — kei konei mātou
home.heroSubtitle: He tūmataiti. He haumaru ahurea. He mea hanga mō Aotearoa — mō te pakanga me te haringa.
home.heroDescription: He papatono motuhake, tūmataiti-tuatahi mō ngā whānau o ngā pēpi matua: ngā ratonga me ngā mōhiotanga i ngā wā uaua, me te wāhi hei whakanui i ngā tohu angitu, ngā tuatahitanga, me te hari o tēnei wāhanga.
home.intro: Whakatere i te tautoko me te mana. Tiakina ngā taonga. Whakanuia te ahunga whakamua.

roleSelector.title: Nau mai, haere mai
roleSelector.subtitle: Ahakoa he taumaha, he tūmanako rānei te rā, kei te wāhi tika koe. Hei tautoko i ngā whānau o ngā pēpi matua puta noa i Aotearoa.
roleSelector.parentDescription: He tautoko, he mōhiotanga, he wāhi e whakanui ana i te mahi uaua me ngā wā hari o tō haerenga
roleSelector.practitionerDescription: Ngā taputapu, te whakahaere rārangi, me te arotake e tiaki ana i te haumaru me te whakamanawa i te whānau
roleSelector.choosePortal: Kōwhiria tō whatunga ki te haere tonu

features.title: I hangaia mō te haerenga katoa
features.subtitle: Ko te haumaru ahurea me te tūmataiti te pūtake — me te wāhi mō te tūmanako, te katakata, me te whakanui.
features.privacyDescription: Ka tiakina ō raraunga. Ko ngā ara tūmataiti-tuatahi me te whakaae — ko koe te kaiwhakatau.
features.directoryDescription: Kimihia ngā ratonga, ngā rōpū tautoko, me ngā tohunga puta noa i Aotearoa — tae atu ki ngā tautoko e āwhina ana i te whānau ki te noho hono me te tohu i te ahunga whakamua.
features.culturalDescription: I hoahoa ki Te Tiriti. I hoahoa kia hāngai ki ngā mātāpono o Te Mana Raraunga ina pā ana ngā pānga raraunga Māori.
features.supportDescription: Ngā whānau e mārama ana ki ngā pō NICU — me te oranga ngākau o ngā rongo pai, te piki o te taumaha, me te hoki ki te kāinga.
features.guidesDescription: He mōhiotanga i reo māmā, i āta arotakehia — he āwhina mahi, kāore e pehia tō ake kōrero.
features.aiDescription: He kaiārahi māmā, huatau-anake hei whakatere mōhiotanga — he mārama, ehara i te whakakapi mō tō rōpū tiaki.

values.title: Ō mātou tū
values.subtitle: Ko tō mātou kaupapa e pupuri ana i te pakanga me te haringa.
values.manaDescription: E tū ana ki te mana motuhake me te rangatiratanga o te whānau i ia whakawhitinga.
values.whanauDescription: Ka tautokohia te whānau katoa — tuākana, hoa, koro, kuia — te hunga e tiri ana i te māharahara me ngā angitu.
values.tikaDescription: He mōhiotanga tōtika, tika, e hāngai ana ki te ahurea — i ngā wā katoa.
values.manaakiDescription: He tiaki pono i ia āhuatanga — tae atu ki te tika ki te kata, ki te okioki, ki te whakanui i te ahunga whakamua.
